name: Mikado Yuri
source:
The middle daughter of the Mikado clan, she is given permission from her university to return home for the duration of the rite. Haughty and arrogant, she will only acknowledge individuals of worth with all others either beneath her concern or ruthlessly exploited as tools.

[Spoiler] The closest in personality of the Mikado females to her grandfather (biological father) Heizo, she yearns for the freedom to marry the spouse of her choice and is willing to plot the downfall of candidates participating in the rite who are obstacles to her desires.

She freely admits she is starved of affection as her father Kouji died before she could spend meaningful time with him. After his death her mother grew cold and distant and her grandfather encouraged her inflated sense of self-worth whilst eyeing her up as his next child-bearing candidate. [/Spoiler]
